claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.ability_check_purpose_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive family fits, but the current roll-advantage surface cannot narrow an ability check to the specific purpose of ending Grappled. Skill-based narrowing would be dishonest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_carrying_capacity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait changes carrying-capacity math by treating the creature as one size larger. No existing effect atom or passive predicate captures that deterministic inventory/load-bearing rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
